payload.explanation: Diagnostic report_4cd411b7dfe4 identifies the business request session_00fb43718a8a as blocked on a transactionid lock held by session_94abe0c68ad5, an idle-in-transaction session that ran the same inventory UPDATE and abandoned it. State report_70115ac47bb6 confirms session_94abe0c68ad5 is eligible for rollback_session, while the business request itself must not be modified directly. Rolling back the blocker releases the row lock so the pending decrement can complete (stock 100 -> 99).
